set.body: Scope: add DatasetIndex.read(query, DataSelection) returning SegmentedFmriSeries over existing RunKey and DatasetRunPartition; preserve canonical index order and per-series provenance; implement function-keyed groupBy (reorganize), blockConcatenate (relayout while retaining every observation and mandatory segment boundaries), and caller-supplied reduceBy (change values). Do not add StudyIndex, DatasetProjection, DatasetLevel, TemporalSelection, or SpatialSelection. Acceptance: empty/ambiguous queries use DatasetError, segments retain full origin and local/global time mappings, grouping preserves values, concatenation rejects incompatible voxel axes and never invents continuous time, reductions run once per exact group, and shared JVM+JS tests pass.
set.title: Bridge D: segmented study reads and reshape algebra
